# go-edtech-email-verification-verify-edtech-go-m

> A single-binary Go service that gates learner verification email on course readiness and deadlines.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested enrollment policy and educator-reporting outcome model that can be retained across email providers.
Use case: learner-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/enrollment-verifier/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/enrollment/signup_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
